newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia may delay drawing IMF loan - govt source.
newsitem.headline: Russia may delay drawing IMF loan - govt source.

text.p: Russia may delay drawing some of its current $10 billion three-year loan from the International Monetary Fund to 1999 from 1998, a senior government source said on Tuesday.

The source said Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin had agreed the delay with the finance ministry because of possible funding problems in 1999, but the cabinet would take a final decision on Thursday.
The source also said Russia's draft 1998 budget assumes gross domestic product will grow by two percent, ending eight years of decline, and inflation will more than halve to five percent
